definitions.gloss: paddy rice; rice grown in flooded fields
definitions.explanation: Rice cultivated in flooded paddy fields, as opposed to rice grown in dry fields. The standard method of rice farming in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{水稲|すいとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{主|しゅ}だ。
examples.english: In Japan, paddy rice is the main type.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{水稲|すいとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{栽培|さいばい}→栽培：13108_saibai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{盛|さか}ん→盛ん：01239_sakan⟧だ。
examples.english: Paddy rice cultivation is thriving in this region.

examples.japanese: {水稲|すいとう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{田|た}→田：03380_ta⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}って→張る：12583_haru⟧⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Because paddy rice is grown with water flooded into the fields, managing the water is very important.

notes:
An agricultural term contrasting with {陸稲|りくとう} (upland/dry-field rice). Almost all rice in Japan is {水稲|すいとう}, grown in flooded paddies.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {陸稲|りくとう}: upland rice — grown in ordinary dry fields without flooding
- ⟦{稲|いね}→稲：01820_ine⟧: rice plant — the plant itself, regardless of growing method
- ⟦{田|た}→田：03380_ta⟧・⟦{水田|すいでん}→水田：13262_suiden⟧: rice paddy — the flooded field where {水稲|すいとう} is grown
